points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, orchestrating autonomous agents to detect and resolve context errors in complex workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for technical root cause analysis.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring reliable performance of agentic systems.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and optimizing latency for real-time telemetry processing.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for network workflows, reducing redundant alerts by 25%, directly applying statistical methods to system observability.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI agents using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for automated resolution tasks.
